lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A structured 2D array of high-luminance circular clusters organized into approximately five vertical columns. Spots within each column exhibit semi-regular vertical spacing, forming a grid-like pattern across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are visible, intersecting the circular blobs to form a nodal coordinate system where the spots represent high-intensity maxima on the vertical axes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible along the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient transition with light-colored pixels on the dorsal aspect and deep shadows on the ventral aspect.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin in the lower-left foreground contains a high-density population of small, high-luminance spots that are significantly smaller in diameter than the primary clusters on the lateral flank.
